notes: **Improved:** Diagnostics no longer surface License Manager Service or Xbox Live Networking Service as status rows or detected issues.
**Improved:** The live player count now refreshes automatically while the launcher stays open.
**Improved:** Install checks recognize Microsoft Visual C++ v14 Redistributable (x86) build `14.50.35719`.

**Changed:** Default location for new game downloads/installs is `%USERPROFILE%\Games\Shadowrun` instead of under Program Files, so extraction stays user-writable without relying on Program Files ACLs or UAC.
**Fixed:** Skip Intro (Uninstall Mod) in Settings stays in sync with the game folder after moving files or when the game is found but a system dependency still reports missing.
**Added:** Live player counter (in-game community count; accuracy may vary while migration is ongoing).
**Added:** Diagnostics slider for launcher background music volume with the value remembered for next launch.
**Changed:** Default background music level for new installs is half of the previous default (quieter first launch).
**Removed:** Diagnostics “Common Error Fixes” (License Manager / Xbox Networking / SFC quick actions and related IPC); service rows remain with manual guidance where relevant.
**Removed:** Separate Diagnostics “GPU Checker” panel (GPU still appears in full diagnostics).
**Added:** AntHill LIVE (AHL) server toggle in Diagnostics: leave off for Microsoft GFWL endpoints or enable for AntHill LIVE; missing AHL files download automatically from releases when needed.
**Improved:** Main process refactored into smaller modules (window, downloads, game, diagnostics, updater, activation, logging, etc.) without intended behavior changes.
**Improved:** Logging consolidated to `safeLog` / `%APPDATA%\Shadowrun FPS Launcher\logs\main.log` (rotate at 1 MB).
**Improved:** Activation, PCID, and .NET helper code moved into dedicated files (flows unchanged).
**Added:** Richer update error notifications (network, timeout, server, etc.).
**Added:** Stalled-download detection with ~3-minute timeout and user notification.
**Added:** One-click retry for failed downloads without re-checking for updates.
**Added:** Restart-time detection of failed installs with clearer messaging.
**Added:** Manual installer download when auto-update cannot finish.
**Improved:** Clearer error classification and troubleshooting text.
**Improved:** More reliable download progress feedback.
**Improved:** Post-install verification on restart.
**Improved:** Error dialogs with retry, manual download, and dismiss options.
**Added:** Browse for an existing game installation when files live outside default paths.
**Improved:** Saved game folder persists across sessions and focus changes.
**Improved:** Any folder name works when it contains `Shadowrun.exe`.
**Improved:** Mod statuses (Skip Intro, DXVK, FPS, srs_shadowrun.dll) refresh after changing location.
**Improved:** Launcher re-checks when files move or rename while it is open.
**Added:** Move game files after install.
**Added:** GPU vendor detection with links to vendor updaters.
**Added:** Run Windows SFC elevated via Diagnostics.
**Added:** Launcher hides while the game runs.
**Improved:** Game move workflow, UI polish, and related reliability.
**Added:** In-app changelog and history.
**Added:** DXVK toggle for compatibility.
**Added:** srs_shadowrun.dll version switcher.
**Added:** Diagnostics and troubleshooting tools.
**Added:** Automatic launcher updates.
**Improved:** Game activation path.
**Improved:** Download progress feedback.
